# Linen thread

Type: Material | Internal ID: LinenThread | Source: Spinning wheel | Usage: Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Flax x1

# Introduction

Linen thread is an item used in the creation of higher tier weapons and gear.

## Availability

• Crafted from Flax at a Spinning wheel.
• The Spinning wheel takes an average of 30 seconds to produce one Linen thread.

Categorias: Materials
